title: Drift King Rush
description: Hold through tight winding asphalt curves to sling your race car into buttery one-thumb drifts, rack up lap combos, and upgrade faster rides.
controls: Press and hold on screen to hook into corners and drift smoothly; release on straightaways to rocket ahead.

zh-CN.title: 全民漂移
zh-CN.description: 魔性一指挂钩甩尾漂移赛车：入弯长按贴弯极限漂移、出弯松手全速冲刺，升级爱车刷爆赛道连击纪录！
zh-CN.controls: 靠近弯道时长按屏幕钩住弯心漂移过弯，出弯松手恢复直线全速冲刺。
